# Vendored desktop plugin

`quickCapture/` is an unmodified snapshot of hthienloc/dms-plugins, subdirectory
quickCapture, commit e12fe2f7da3d97e08ab2032f6c943e18480779b5 (plugin version 5.10.1).
Source: https://github.com/hthienloc/dms-plugins/tree/e12fe2f7da3d97e08ab2032f6c943e18480779b5/quickCapture
MIT copyright notice is preserved in quickCapture/LICENSE.

Only the plugin subtree is included. This makes restoration independent of the
plugin manager's mutable cache and avoids fetching the full multi-plugin repo.
Update this snapshot and provenance deliberately; the deployed plugin is Nix-owned.
